title: a logged deviation credits every file with the same name
detail: consistency._declared_deviations records each logged path and also its file name, and _is_declared credits by name, so DEV-001: api/util.py credits web/util.py, or any other util.py, at the builder boundary. v0.237.1 removed only the string-suffix branch. The name credit is what lets a logged partial path (errors/E.ts) credit src/errors/E.ts, so the fix is to compare trailing path segments, and count how field deviations.md files use bare names first.
